title: CamelSean
tagline: An AI agent that distributes tokens by tracking user interactions.
description: This project is a AI agent driven app that send tokens to user based on their interactions with our client's app. The clients give AI agent several contracts that deploy on Base or their X accounts, the AI agent will tracks users' transactions on the contracts and interactions with the X accounts. AI agnet will evaluate the users activities and give them token rewards.
how_its_made: The project use coinbase's agent kit to build a AI agent and use NODIT'S node key to retrieve Base net's data. Metal's apis are used for create tokens by clients and used by AI agent to send tokens for the user. React is used for building front-end and vercel is used to deploy it.
